declared_precision.name: mixed_bf16 (ops/precision.py MIXED_BF16, applied before AD to init, sequence, body and terminal functions)
declared_precision.products: every linear/matmul/addmm and every batched product (window-attention scores and values, inner-learning chain products) takes BF16 operands, accumulates in FP32 and rounds its result once to BF16, then widens exactly
declared_precision.fp32: master parameters, optimizer state, gradient accumulation (per-use VJPs), normalization, RoPE, softmax, activations, residual stream, loop carry (fast weights U, Dn and the loss accumulator), losses; Muon Newton-Schulz in BF16 exactly as the donor
declared_precision.fused_attention: an installed fused attention body must reproduce the captured mixed rounding points (s = bf16(q k^T), x = fl(s op c) + mask, FP32 softmax, P rounded to BF16 only as the value-product operand, O/dQ/dK/dV rounded once to BF16); FP32 summation order and online-softmax rescaling may differ (FP32 association); masked tiles may be skipped only under an exact-zero guard
declared_precision.reference: arithmetic reference = eager PyTorch evaluation of the same formulation under ops.precision.precision_policy('mixed_bf16') in FP32 on the same H100 and state; FP64 reference = eager FP64 autograd of the unpolicied formulation

native_gates_mixed.causality: prefix losses bitwise unchanged under byte edits from chunk j for counts <= j-1 and changed for counts >= j (unchanged C-OPS4-A rule)
native_gates_mixed.repeat: same state and data: loss, gradients, new parameters bitwise identical
native_gates_mixed.counts: runtime counts 0, 1, chunks/2, chunks with the same binary
native_gates_mixed.states: fresh init and after trained updates

score.metric: native generated complete-update ms / fastest learning-valid conventional complete-update ms on the fixed primary case
score.clock: complete changing-state update with CUDA events around one native launch or one CUDA-graph replay; staged batches (4 synthetic batches cycled) and schedule row outside the events; forward, loss, backward, casts, optimizer and state included
score.pairing: native and controls each in a fresh process on the same H100 in the same job, at least two rounds with reversed order; median of round medians
score.memory_setup: reported separately: torch peaks, native arena, CPU capture/lower/nvcc, GPU load; conventional compile/capture

prohibitions: no benchmark-name dispatch, donor monkeypatches, whole-model handwritten replacement or external-kernel graph counted as the megakernel; one generated cooperative kernel per complete update; rejected V4 group rules are not enabled unless their race is diagnosed, fixed and qualified explicitly; failures preserved, gates never loosened

declared_precision_online.declared_before: any build, gate or learning run that uses it (first use: cpu-25)
declared_precision_online.name: mixed_bf16_online (ops/precision.py MIXED_BF16_ONLINE, attention="bfloat16_online")
declared_precision_online.function_level: identical casts/products to mixed_bf16 (same capture-level graph)
declared_precision_online.changed_arithmetic: only inside a fused window attention (ops/window_attention.py, kernels/attention_window.cuh online phases): x = fl(bf16(q k^T) * c') + mask with c' = RN(1/c) for x/c; per 16-row block, computed 64-key blocks in the exact kernel order (unmasked ascending, then masked candidates ascending); running max m; p = __expf(x - m) (hardware ex2); l and O = sum bf16(p) v rescaled by __expf(m_old - m_new) per block; O = bf16(O * RN(1/l)); backward P = __expf(x - m) * RN(1/l), delta_i = sum_d dO_id O_id (FP32), dS = bf16(fl(P * fl(bf16(dP) - delta)) * c'); dQ/dK/dV rounded once to BF16. This is the arithmetic family of the conventional control's FlexAttention (online softmax, unnormalized BF16 probabilities).
declared_precision_online.arithmetic_reference: eager definition of the fused operations (window_attention._online_forward/_online_backward, torch.exp instead of ex2) used by CPU replay of the rewritten graph
declared_precision_online.gates: unchanged: native_gates_mixed (vs eager mixed_bf16 reference and FP64) and learning_gates; no gate is loosened; the exact-arithmetic builds remain the reported fallback

declared_precision_online.v2_result: FAILED (P8-C gpu-28, preserved): m8k after 10 updates, count 64: native loss error 1.611e-6 > bound 1.0e-6 (floor; eager mixed error below 2.5e-7); all w32 checks (incl. after 20) and all fresh m8k checks passed. Speed: 21.61 ms vs exact 23.59 ms (gpu-27/28). Interpretation: the online rounding points decorrelate native from the eager mixed graph, so trained-state loss errors are compared against occasionally tiny eager errors. Not qualified; no further online variants are pursued for this campaign.
